title: Drivers Fined for Leaving Engines of Stationary or Parked Vehicles Idling
what_it_is: Drivers Fined for Leaving Engines of Stationary or Parked Vehicles Idling

sections.label: Idling engine offences and penalties
sections.summary: NEA increased idling engine penalties in 2016, and offences fell from 6,400 cases in 2016 to 2,800 in 2019, with repeat offenders dropping from 19 to one.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: NEA has also stepped up checks and increased the penalty for idling engine offences in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The number of idling engine offences increased from 2,000 cases in 2009 to 6,400 cases in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The concerted efforts by NEA since 2016 have led to a reduction to 3,200 cases in 2018 and further down to 2,800 in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The number of repeat offenders also decreased from 19 cases in 2016 to only one in 2019.

sections.label: Idling engine public education outreach
sections.summary: Since December 2016 idling engine regulations and penalties were included in the Highway Code handbook and theory test, and over 1.3 million educational pamphlets were distributed since 2011.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since December 2016, we have included the idling engine regulations as well as the penalty regime in the Handbook on Highway Code under the Eco-driving section and in the theory test.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I agree with the Member that we need to look at even more ways for effective public outreach and education efforts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have actually stepped up enforcement blitzes at hotspots and increased the penalties since 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And since 2011, we have distributed more than 1.3 million educational pamphlets and flyers through various means – through the private vehicle fleet owners, schools, authorised vehicles inspection centres and so on.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will continue to look at ways for more effective public education and outreach efforts.
